positions.title: Java Development Student
positions.description:
CAREminder - Developing a Java medication reminder application using Spring Boot and PostgreSQL for patients to coordinate medication adherence between multiple caregivers.

Virtual Vending Machine - Developed Java console program to display, purchase, and receive change using object-oriented principles and defensive programming.

National Parks Reservation System - Created Java console program to interact with PostgreSQL when users navigate the system to check for existing reservations and schedule a reservation in the Park system.

Tenmo App - Developed Java application using Spring Boot to make custom API calls with customer data in SQL database.

positions.title: Operations Specialist
positions.description:
- Project lead for successful partnership with external addiction treatment facility to grow revenue streams.

- Lead the development and implementation of standard operating procedures across outpatient offices to streamline patient care.

- Created patient recruitment strategy to double patient volume in six months of implementation at outpatient office in new geographic market.

- Implemented and trained staff on use of new practice management software.

company.name: The Centers for Families and Children

positions.title: Manager, Governance & Special Projects
positions.description:
- Developed project plan for affiliation with health centers to redesign service line delivery and tracked progress with cross-functional project teams.

- Implemented organizational summaries for Strategy Team to identify partnership opportunities for service integration.

- Created corporate compliance and governance tools to ensure Federal regulation requirements were attained.

- Created a business strategy dashboard to measure outcomes and communicate impact across the organization’s service portfolio.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
- Lead the development of timelines to track implementation of the organization’s strategic plan.

- Implemented Business Intelligence tools and dashboards to monitor operational indicators and
identify trends, as well as developing outcome measures to communicate impact on clients served.

- Lead cross-functional project teams through the entire project life cycle.

- Created reports and research briefs for the executive team to use for advocacy and funding requests.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with the Vice President of Program Strategy, Alignment, and Partnerships.

- Interpreted large data sets to quantify retention and attendance levels for Early Learning Program.

- Updated budget projections into actuals for the Finance Department.

- Assisted in the monthly performance evaluation of Early Learning sites to improve financial well-being and efficacy.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Assisted in the development of data for psychological publication.

- Conducted experiments regarding blood donation attitudes.

- Utilized statistical software for proper data input and analysis.

- Along with the lead researcher and other assistants, we compiled and analyzed quantitative data from 412 participants.

- The study was accepted for presentation to the national conference of The Society for Behavioral Medicine.
